description: Move one date in a content calendar and let the linked dates follow: concept, shoot, edit, review and publish stay in order, a shared shoot day moves all its posts together, finished steps never move. Returns the change list, conflicts, blocked steps, a confirmation flag and the updated posts. Stateless: you send up to 40 posts, nothing is stored. Returns: JSON with language, move, changes, blocked, conflicts, group_change, detached_from_group, needs_confirmation, summary, posts, coverage. PAID: 0.02 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing. NOTE: Pure date arithmetic, German or English messages (language), no AI model. Send keys, optional short titles and dates only, no personal data. A confirmation flag means you should review the change list before you apply it to your own calendar; nothing is written anywhere by this service.

publish_mode.description: Publish moves: also shift the unfinished steps by the same number of days, or only the publish date.

shoot_mode.description: Shoot step of a grouped post: move the whole shoot day, or detach this post from the group.

done.description: Steps that are already finished; they are never moved.

shoot_group.description: Posts with the same value share one shoot day and move together.

title.description: Optional label echoed in messages. No personal data.

name: content_plan_shift
